recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, split-composition layout featuring a desaturated portrait in a vertical frame on the left, set against a vibrant red background with heavy, dark fluid drips on the right, utilizing distressed textures and eclectic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between a clean portrait frame and a chaotic textured field
Juxtaposition of formal attire with macabre tools and fluid textures
Color blocking using primary red as a structural foundation
Typographic overlap between the portrait frame and the red field
coreInvariants: Heavy vertical fluid drips on the right third
Distressed, grainy film texture across the entire image
A desaturated, high-contrast portrait within a defined rectangular inset

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait subject occupies the upper-left quadrant, scaled to approximately 40% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized title text at the center-left acts as the primary focal point connecting the two halves.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the portrait, moves down to the bold title, then follows the vertical drips on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The lower-left and upper-right areas provide breathing room through solid color and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep crimson red serves as the background and structural base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated black and white for the portrait and secondary text blocks.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange and off-white for the primary title typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red field contrasts with the low-saturation, high-value portrait.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Eclectic mix of condensed sans-serif and decorative slab-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Letters are tightly kerned and often overlapping
Intentional vertical stretching of specific glyphs
Integration of illustrative elements like knife-like strokes into letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'I' is replaced with a vertical blade shape
The 'R' features an elongated, sweeping tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine a chaotic, custom-lettered title with rigid, boxed sans-serif metadata for a 'classified document' feel.
graphicDevices: Rectangular bounding boxes for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the condensed, heavy skeleton for the upper title line.
Matches the raw, industrial feel of the lower title line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image: on the left, a desaturated noir portrait of a man in a suit holding a shovel; on the right, a vibrant red background with thick, dark vertical drips. Apply a heavy film grain and dust texture overall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line title in the center-left using custom vector lettering. The top line should be white and condensed; the bottom line should be orange and decorative with a backwards 'E'. Add small metadata text in boxed frames in the lower-left.

verificationChecks: Is the 'E' in the title reversed?
Are there thick drips on the right side?
Is the portrait desaturated compared to the red background?
Does the title overlap the portrait frame?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure drips look viscous and vertical
Verify the title text is legible despite the distortion
Confirm the portrait is correctly inset and framed
Check that the red is deep and saturated
recipe.reuseFormula: Noir Portrait + Crimson Drip Field + Distressed Custom Typography = Macabre Thriller Aesthetic
